name: SI@UCF AI, Robotics, and Entrepreneurship
what_you_do: One week day program with hands-on projects on AI, robotics and entrepreneurship. Cost is $350.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 8 to 11 when they apply (rising 9th to 12th) who are at least 13 when the institute starts. Up to 35 students.
duration: 1 week (June 8 to 12 in 2026), at UCF Rosen Campus, 9907 Universal Blvd, Orlando
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran June 8 to 12. Summer 2027 dates will be announced in January.
how_to_apply: Apply through the SI@UCF application page. The page showed applications open for Summer 2026; check it for the next window.
